title: MallWorld Experiences that are kinda different than what most people describe but still feel like MallWorld?
content: Hi, I usually just lurk on reddit but r/MallWorld is one of the reasons i found reddit in the first place. I have recurring MallWorld dreams but my experiences seem slightly different than what most people on here describe & im just wondering if anyone else shares similar experiences to mine in MallWorld? First, most people describe their MallWorld as eerie & slightly “off”. My MallWorld is usually lively & vibes are chill & relatively happy if not just neutral, nothing really eerie about it. Second, my parents & family have been in my MallWorld dreams a few times. (not every time). Third, my MallWorld seems kind of upscale or at least nice, whereas many people describe their MallWorld as being kind of run down. However, my MallWorld has backrooms that do give off a ghostly vibe but i never feel scared or like i should get out of there. i always want to keep exploring. i do go back to same locations from previous MallWorld dreams & when i do, it’s like “oh yea i remember this place from 2 years ago! let’s see if there’s anything i missed or if anything has changed” Also, outside of my family members, only 5 people from waking life have ever appeared in my MallWorld dreams. 1 of those people has shown up in 2 separate dreams. i’m not close with this person & have not spoken to them in several years. just someone i hung out with a few times in college like 5-6 years ago. Does anyone else see the same people from their real lives in MallWorld? Lastly, I never work at mallworld. i’m always usually a patron buying stuff, eating at a cafe, or just checking out the scene. sometimes i feel like i’ve been sent there to observe or experience & report it back to some entity (no idea who) later. Am I a Watcher? (I never feel like i’m spying or following anyone in particular tho, just literally vibing the scene but for reasons i’m not clear on) Would like to hear if other people have MallWorld experiences similar to mine
